Numpy
designed for fast numerical computing
Data structure - ndarray [n- dimentional array]

It is similar to python list but as we know, python list can store HETROGENEOUS (int, float, string, etc) which makes it slower to process but in Numpy
it uses HOMOGENEOUS data (Numbers) which makes it faster to process 

Numpy is faster to process (they are optimised in C).
It stores memory in blocks
Uses less memory (python stores extra metadata with it which makes it memory heavier)
Built-in mathemetical functions 
Supports direct vectorized operations
